oneShotOnly.summary: One-shot sendNativeMessage() diagnostics reach the native host, but the persistent connectNative() lane is disconnected.
oneShotOnly.recommendedAction: Trigger an immediate persistent reconnect; the host manifest appears reachable.

reconnectPending.summary: One-shot sendNativeMessage() diagnostics reach the native host, but the persistent connectNative() lane is still disconnected and waiting to reconnect.
reconnectPending.recommendedAction: Wait for or trigger an immediate persistent reconnect; the host manifest appears reachable.

degraded.summary: Persistent lane is connected but health is degraded; one-shot native diagnostics still reach the host.
degraded.recommendedAction: Reseat the long-lived native port and compare persistent vs one-shot host identity.

unreachable.summary: Neither the persistent lane nor one-shot diagnostics currently confirm native-host reachability.
unreachable.recommendedAction: Inspect native-host installation, manifest targets, and browser logs, then retry reconnect.
